contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with and complementary to corroborated FND-0031 (pure m=0 corner reduces to the depth-one Gysin cokernel of THM-0003) and FND-0032 (undecorated CGP top-weight is the wrong corner), and with mechanically verified FND-0001 / RED-0001 (open input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} ≅ gr^W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d)). Primary purity check against SRC-0002 (CLP arXiv:2307.08830v3): the right-exact sequences H^{k-2}(∂̃M_{g,n})→H^k(M̄_{g,n})→W_k H^k(M_{g,n})→0 and dual BM form (6.1) H_k(∂̃)→H_k(M̄)→W_{-k}H_k(M)→0 exhibit the open pure-weight piece as a quotient of pure compactified cohomology of matching weight, hence pure of that single weight; for the RED-0001 ordinary dual k=2d-16 one has weight=degree so the graded piece is pure of weight 2d-16 (for (6,6): d=21, weight 26; dual BM weight −16). Semisimplicity: SRC-0002 explicitly records that the Hodge structure on cohomology of a smooth proper Deligne–Mumford stack is semi-simple (ss notation in Thm 1.1 is needed only for ℓ-adic Galois representations); classically the abelian category of polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of a fixed weight is semisimple (Deligne Théorie de Hodge II), so every short exact sequence in that category splits and every object is a direct sum of simples. Geometric graded pieces of MHS on moduli are polarizable, so the pure weight-(2d-16) row of the Deligne weight spectral sequence and the target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} live in that semisimple category. Consequently: (i) any subquotient of a direct sum of Tate objects Q(±w/2) of that fixed weight is again a direct sum of the same Tate object; (ii) there is no non-split-extension obstruction inside this pure corner; (iii) there is no semisimplification-versus-actual-isomorphism gap for Q-Hodge structures here (unlike Galois representations, or unlike mixed corners such as the nonsplit extension 0→H^1(C)→H^1(C∖S)→Q(−1)^{m−1}→0 used by FND-0020/FND-0027). Mild scope note only: the finding does not assert that the target is itself Tate—only that once contributing pure fixed-weight terms are shown Tate, subquotients and the pure corner itself inherit Tate type as honest HS isomorphisms without exotic-extension bookkeeping. Distinct from FND-0031 (which strata contribute) and FND-0032 (top-weight CGP mismatch): do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from legacy_artifact to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of purity of the graded piece, semisimplicity of polarizable pure Q-HS of fixed weight, and the resulting absence of extension/ss gaps at this pure corner.
